name: Coastal Proving Ground - environment and release cradle
description: Initial complete asset kit. Material-faithful family views and three release phases reviewed. Destination placement, hero clearance and final scene lighting remain integration work.
brief: Kiln-authored coastal deck, uneven shore, hangar, animated mechanical cradle, human scale truck, props and intact targets for the 79.25 metre Jaeger demo.
